dod_intent_evidence: Multiple Air Force SBIR Phase II awards (AFSOC AR drone navigation, 2020) and a company press release announcing a $950M ceiling USAF IDIQ — SBIR record and news sections, on their own site.
score_evidence: "NO GPS. NO COMMS. VISION SOLUTIONS AT THE EDGE." and "a full time operational team deployed in Ukraine" → deployment_awareness_absence scored very low; DDIL is literally the product premise and they field a team in theater

Team page lists "Test Pilot Lead", "Director of Testing & Integrations", "Director of IT, CyberSec & Compliance"; open roles are UAS Flight Test Operators and a Director of UAS Flight Operations → hiring_profile_skew scored low
"Battle-Tested Versatility: Proven on Group 1-4 UAS platforms and manned aircraft" → operator/fielding framing dominates over lab metrics

blind_spots.blind_spot: The $950M number is a ceiling IDIQ, not funded work — task orders must still be won one at a time, and the maturation-across-platforms scope means every task order has its own months-to-field clock
blind_spots.operator_reality: A ceiling award converts to fielded capability only through per-platform integration, airworthiness, and GFE/prime flow-down work on each task order; the IDIQ headline can outpace the delivery machinery of a ~31-person team
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Press-release framing rewards the ceiling figure; the transition mechanics underneath it are unglamorous and unstaffed relative to the scope claimed
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Vermeer has been awarded a $950,000,000 ceiling indefinite-delivery/indefinite quantity contract for the maturation, demonstration and proliferation of capability across platforms and domains

blind_spots.blind_spot: VPS depends on "a locally stored 2.5D or 3D map database" — the map logistics chain (who builds, updates, classifies, and pushes theater map data to each platform) is never addressed
blind_spots.operator_reality: At an austere site, stale or missing map tiles for the operating area turn a jam-proof navigator into a paperweight; map currency becomes a sustainment task some E-5 owns with no published workflow
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The engineering story centers on the vision algorithm; data sustainment is a fielding problem that only surfaces after the demo
blind_spots.evidence_quote: the system maps real-time video to a locally stored 2.5D or 3D map database to generate an accurate location signal

blind_spots.blind_spot: Testimonials are operator- and general-level enthusiasm ("Every warfighter needs this") with no named program of record — enthusiasm without a funded advocacy chain is the classic pre-transition trap
blind_spots.operator_reality: Operators loving a capability in Ukraine does not move a US program office; without a PM champion each SBIR-to-IDIQ step still has to clear acquisition gates on someone else's timeline
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Demand-side pull has been strong enough that the company may not yet feel the gap between endorsement and programmed dollars
blind_spots.evidence_quote: “This is very impressive technology. Every warfighter needs this.” General J. Poss, U.S. Air Force

opener_hook: Vermeer's $950M USAF award is a ceiling IDIQ — the fielding math happens task order by task order, where a 31-person team's months-to-field is the binding constraint, not the ceiling.
what_they_do: Vision-based GPS-denied navigation (VPS) for drones and aircraft in contested, jammed, and spoofed environments.
